verdict.rationale: Recurring scheduled jobs or workflows, such as scheduled reports, cohort syncs or recurring exports, are a fair axis for an analytics platform, but the evidence pack never documents an Amplitude scheduling capability. The export, cohort and dashboard APIs are one-off actions that a user would have to schedule externally, and third-party integrations like Fivetran are not Amplitude's own scheduler, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
